Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client can terminate the contract immediately without notice and without paying you for work already performed.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your intellectual property transfers to the client upon delivery before you have received full payment.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause "Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.", it currently allows termination without paying for work already performed. I propose changing it to: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the date of termination. - Regarding the clause "All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.", it transfers ownership before full payment is received. I propose changing it to: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable. Best regards,
